dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Tell me about the most challenging project you've worked on.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: I've been building a student timetable application for WKU over the past eight months. The challenge was that I had to learn a new framework while developing it. By the time I launched the first version, I had already rewritten the core architecture twice.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: What did you learn from that experience?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: That beginning poorly is still better than not beginning. Furthermore, the mistakes I made early on helped me understand the system more deeply than I would have if I'd planned everything perfectly from the start.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: I watched the documentary on the Aral Sea last night. It was sobering.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I know — despite the international attention it has received, the remediation efforts have been very slow. As a result, communities near what used to be the sea are still suffering.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: What struck me most was the speed of the decline. By 1990, the sea had already lost more than half its volume. Although some restoration projects have been established in the north, they are very small compared to the original scale.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Nevertheless, the North Aral Sea has recovered slightly. Furthermore, it's become an important case study for what can and cannot be achieved through environmental intervention.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: I've been thinking about what I want to do after WKU. I intend to apply for a journalism position at a national newspaper.

dialogue.speaker: Daniyar
dialogue.text: Is there anything specific you'd like to cover?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Environmental journalism, ideally. The connection between science communication and public action has always interested me. Despite not having a science background, I've been studying ecology independently for two years.

dialogue.speaker: Daniyar
dialogue.text: That's actually an advantage. Scientists can explain what's happening, but they often struggle to communicate it to a general audience. Consequently, science communicators who can bridge that gap are in high demand.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.text: We're discussing whether social media should be regulated. Aizhan, you support regulation.

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Yes. Although I believe in free expression, I also believe that platforms are currently profiting from content that demonstrably harms users. Therefore, some form of accountability is not just justified — it is necessary.

dialogue.speaker: Baglan
dialogue.text: My concern is who decides what is harmful. Furthermore, even well-intentioned regulation can suppress voices that are inconvenient to those in power. Nevertheless, I agree that transparency requirements are reasonable.

questions.text: "Furthermore, mistakes helped me understand more deeply." "Furthermore" signals:
questions.hint: "Furthermore" adds another benefit — beyond just launching the app. ADDITION marker. ✅

questions.text: "As a result, communities are still suffering." "As a result" signals:
questions.hint: "As a result" = consequence. Slow remediation → communities still suffering. ✅

questions.text: "By the time I launched, I ___ the architecture twice." Choose.
questions.hint: "By the time + PS → Past Perfect." "I HAD REWRITTEN the architecture twice." ✅

questions.text: "___ the attention, remediation has been slow." Choose.
questions.hint: "DESPITE the attention" — noun (no verb) → "despite." ✅

questions.text: "A monitoring programme ___ (establish) near the sea." (ongoing now)
questions.hint: Ongoing now → Present Continuous Passive: "IS BEING ESTABLISHED." ✅

questions.text: "She ___ (study) ecology independently for two years." (up to now)
questions.hint: Duration up to now → Present Perfect Continuous: "HAS BEEN STUDYING." ✅

questions.text: "Therefore, accountability is necessary." "Therefore" signals:
questions.hint: "Therefore" = A proves/leads to B. Logical consequence. ✅

questions.text: "___ I believe in free expression, I also believe in accountability." Choose.
questions.hint: "ALTHOUGH I believe..." — full clause (subject + verb). Contrast/concession. ✅

questions.text: "She intend to apply for journalism." — What is wrong?
questions.hint: ✅ "She INTENDS to apply." — third person singular needs -s. Modal-like verbs still conjugate!

questions.text: "Social media regulation ___ (discuss) widely now." (ongoing passive)
questions.hint: "IS BEING DISCUSSED" = Present Continuous Passive. Ongoing now. ✅

questions.text: "I intend to focus on remediation." "Remediation" means:
questions.hint: "remediation" = the process of cleaning up and restoring contaminated land or water.

questions.text: "Accountability is necessary." "Accountability" means:
opts: Being responsible and answerable for actions
questions.correct: Being responsible and answerable for actions
questions.hint: "accountability" = the obligation to explain your actions and be responsible for outcomes.

questions.text: "Transparency requirements are reasonable." "Transparency" means:
opts: Openness — making processes visible and understandable
questions.correct: Openness — making processes visible and understandable
questions.hint: "transparency" = openness; making information or processes clear and visible to others.

questions.text: "Bridge the gap." What does this phrase mean?
opts: Connect two different areas; reduce a gap
questions.correct: Connect two different areas; reduce a gap
questions.hint: "bridge the gap" = to connect two things that are separated; to reduce the distance or difference between them.

questions.text: "The results were sobering." "Sobering" means:
opts: Making you think seriously about a difficult truth
questions.correct: Making you think seriously about a difficult truth
questions.hint: "sobering" = causes you to think seriously; a sobering experience is humbling and makes you face a difficult reality.
